en: ...You really did just come here and rip[/n]right through us, didn't you?[/p]Ahahaha, fantastic! I almost want to[/n]invite you back to our dojo![/p]What do you think of Wasabi as a title?

en: Here to take me up on my offer, Wasabi?[/p]Much as I'd like to, you have your own[/n]journey, and you're very close to the[/l]end.[/p]Go on, then! We're on your side, so don't[/n]be defeated now!

小瑶!小瑶!

en: Team Aqua can't even fund uniforms[/n]now? Go on, get gone!

en: Look, I can't be bothered fighting you.[/n]Just... go away. Don't make me.
mt: 听着,我懒得跟你打.[/n]只是...走开吧.别逼我.

en: AHHH! An intruder! Outoutoutoutout GET[/n]OUT OF HERE!

en: Can't believe kid trainers are allowed[/n]Go-Goggles... Run home, it's unsafe.

en: RUN, RUN, IT'S- Wait, you're not Norman![/n]Don't scare me like that, brat!
mt: 跑啊,跑啊,危险--等等,你不是诺曼![/n]别吓我啊,臭小鬼!

en: Must be hallucinating... Get lost, mirage[/n]child, I'm watching for intruders.
mt: 一定是幻觉...消失吧,幻影小孩,我[/n]在监视入侵者.

en: Right before shift rotation? You[/n]messed up your timing.
mt: 换班前一刻?你[/n]来的时间不对.

en: Have we met somewhere...? Eh, not[/n]important. Go on, scoot.
mt: 我们是不是在哪见过...?唉,不重要[/n]了.快走吧.
又一个入侵者?

en: Norman: [玩家], great to see you!
mt: 诺曼: [玩家],见到你真高兴!

en: Take over for me, will you?
mt: 帮我顶一下班好吗?
岩浆队小兵: 等等,等等--!

en: Magma Grunt: So not ONLY do I need to[/n]fight a Gym Leader, he tags someone[/l]else in halfway through?
mt: 岩浆队小兵: 不仅要[/n]打道馆馆主,他中途还[/l]换人了?
太离谱了!
今天越来越糟糕了...
我完了...

en: Norman: I'm a little surprised to see[/n]you here, [玩家]. I expected[/l]Flannery.
mt: 诺曼: 在这里看到[/n]你让我有点意外,[玩家].我以为[/l]会是弗拉涅[/p]利.

en: Oh, she sent you instead? Hm. I'll need[/n]to have a talk with her later...
mt: 哦,她派你来了?嗯.我得[/n]找她谈谈...

en: But there's no time for that now!
mt: 但现在没时间了!

en: Norman: Team Magma is infiltrating the[/n]pyramid
mt: 诺曼: 岩浆队正在入侵[/n]金字塔.

en: I've got an old friend coming, but it's[/n]too risky for you to fight through.
mt: 我有个老朋友要来,但让你穿过去战[/n]斗太危险了.

en: But they seem to be less dense out to[/n]the east. Maybe you can sneak through?
mt: 不过东边的敌人似乎没那么密集.也[/n]许你可以溜过去?

en: Don't let them catch you! They know I'm[/n]here, but they won't expect you.
mt: 别让他们抓到你!他们知道我在这里,[/n]但不会想到你.

en: Do you feel up to it?
mt: 你觉得自己行吗?

en: Norman: That's my boy. Good luck!
mt: 诺曼: 不愧是我的孩子.祝你好运!

en: Norman: I understand. Go take some time[/n]to prepare, but please hurry!
mt: 诺曼: 我明白了.去准备[/n]一下吧,但请快点!
你回来了!准备好了吗?

mt: 别在意我,我只是个占位符

en: I guess even placeholders can be[/n]defeated
mt: 看来占位符也会[/n]被打败呢

en: This is a dummy text isn't it?
mt: 这是假文本对吧?

en: Norman: Fall back, [玩家], we need[/n]to talk strategy.
mt: 诺曼: 撤退,[玩家],我们[/n]得商量战术.
诺曼: 嘘![玩家]!等等!
诺曼: [玩家],这是布兰登.

en: Norman: Brandon, meet my son[/n][玩家].
mt: 诺曼: 布兰登,认识一下我的儿子[玩家].

en: Norman: Brandon, meet my daughter[/n][玩家].
mt: 诺曼: 布兰登,认识一下我的女儿[玩家].
布兰登: 很高兴见到你,年轻的冒险[/n]家!
诺曼: 布兰登,你的队伍怎么样?

en: Brandon: Exhausted. Yours?[/p]Norman: Also quite tired.
mt: 布兰登: 精疲力竭.你呢?[/p]诺曼: 也很累.

en: Norman: [玩家], you snuck in, you're[/n]still fresh, right?[/p]But that's a lot of Magma members...[/p]What's our plan?
mt: 诺曼: [玩家],你是偷偷溜进来的,你还很精[/n]神,对吧?[/p]但是岩浆队成员太多了...[/p]我们怎么计划?

en: Brandon: Do you two hear that?[/p]Norman: Hear what?[/p]???: OUTTA THE WAY, COMIN' THROUGH!
mt: 布兰登: 你们听到了吗?[/p]诺曼: 什么?[/p]????: 让开,我们要过去!

en: Brandon: ...Well. That answers that![/p]Norman: This is our chance! We'll[/n]support them, you go on ahead!
mt: 布兰登: ...好吧.那正好回答了![/p]诺曼: 这是我们的机会!我们来支援,[/n]你先走!
诺曼: 小心点好吗,[玩家]?

en: This grunt is too busy battling to[/n]notice you.
mt: 这个小兵正忙着战斗,没[/n]注意到你.

en: This grunt is focused on their battle.[/n]They seem to be in trouble...
mt: 这个小兵正专注于战斗.[/n]他看起来遇到麻烦了...

en: I have this under control, you go on[/n]ahead [玩家]!
mt: 这里交给我了,你继续[/n]往前走吧 [玩家]!

en: Hah! Ruins are my homeground! En[/n]guarde!
mt: 哈!遗迹是我的主场!来[/n]吧!

en: How did you get in here?! Those guards[/n]must be sleeping...[/p]Fine, I'll take care of you myself!
mt: 你怎么进来的?!那些卫兵[/n]肯定在睡觉...[/p]好吧,我亲自来对付你!

en: No! No, you can't, we need to- Oops,[/n]nearly gave it away!
mt: 不!不行,你不能,我们需要--糟糕,差[/n]点说漏嘴了!

en: I don't suppose I could convince you to[/n]turn around and head home, could I?
mt: 我能不能说服你[/n]转身回家呢?

en: Hey, this is a historical site, you[/n]oughta be careful!
mt: 嘿,这是历史遗迹,你[/n]要小心点!

en: Wait, you think WE'RE the vandals?!
mt: 等等,你以为我们是破坏者?!

en: What? We're being careful too. It's not[/n]any more ruined than when we arrived.
mt: 什么?我们也小心翼翼的.这里不比我[/n]们来之前更破.

en: Maxie: ...and if that's the Scorched[/n]Slab, then...[/p]then they're at Mt Pyre?
mt: 水梧桐: ...如果那是焦灼石板的话,[/n]那么...他们在烟囱山?[/p]

en: Courtney: Maxie, caution! The meddling[/n]child from Mt Chimney is here.
mt: 露琪亚: 水梧桐,小心!烟囱山那个多[/n]管闲事的小鬼来了.

en: Maxie: NOW?![/p]Argh, I need more time!
mt: 水梧桐: 现在?![/p]可恶,我需要更多时间!
露琪亚,拖住他!
露琪亚,拖住她!

en: I do hope I bought Maxie enough time.
mt: 希望我为水梧桐争取了足够的时间.

诺曼: [玩家],你没事吧?
水梧桐: 是[玩家]啊,嗯?

en: Courtney: Maxie, we should go![/p]Maxie: It's been a pleasure as always,[/n]Archie.
mt: 露琪亚: 水梧桐,我们该走了![/p]水梧桐: 每次都很愉快,[/n]水之团老大.
水梧桐: 再见了,[玩家].
水之团老大: 嗯!

en: Aqua Grunt: Dammit, I was too slow!
mt: 水之队小兵: 可恶,太慢了!

en: Archie: It's alright David, you were[/n]probably out of range anyway.
mt: 水之团老大: 没关系大卫,你可能本[/n]来就在射程之外.

en: Norman: What do you mean by-
mt: 诺曼: 你的意思是--
水之团老大: 快溜!

en: Brandon: That seems... incriminating.[/p]Norman: YES. Yes it does.
mt: 布兰登: 那看起来...很可疑.[/p]诺曼: 是的.确实如此.

en: Anyways, thanks for your help,[/n][玩家]! How's your Gym Challenge[/l]going?[/p]...Four badges? Already? Excellent work![/p]Well, I'd better not keep you waiting,[/n]hm? See you in Petalburg!

en: Brandon: Heh. He's never that excited[/n]to fight me, you know.[/p]Good luck with the Gyms, young[/n]adventurer!
mt: 布兰登: 嘿.他对和我打的时候可没[/n]这么兴奋.[/p]道馆挑战加油,年轻的[/n]冒险家!
